response.justification: Bogdan brings deep, long-tenured hands-on engineering experience across web, embedded, and high-throughput systems, plus genuine open-source credibility (GISCollective founder, D-lang tooling, Linux/Docker/Kubernetes) and a strong knowledge-sharing profile that fits the mentoring aspect of the role. However, the profile is that of an individual contributor/craftsman rather than a development lead: there is no evidence of formal team leadership, technical project management, client-facing consulting, requirements management, or UML/architecture modeling deliverables. Most critically, German is listed as 'Basic' against a hard C1 requirement, and Python is absent from the skills list. Worth a conversation only if the German requirement is negotiable or the role can be shaped toward a lead-architect track.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on development across many stacks and domains
Strong open-source and Linux background; founded and runs an OSS geo-data platform
Proven mentoring/teaching record via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: German at 'Basic' level vs. required C1 — likely disqualifying
No documented people-management, project-management, or client-advisory experience
No evidence of UML modeling, formal architecture design, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership and technical project management track record
Deep engineering breadth and open-source/Linux expertise
